comment.body: The original Quick Accent text corruption was resolved in this thread by increasing the activation delay. The separate spelling-suggestion popup shown near the caret is Windows-owned rather than a PowerToys feature. The remaining request—making the Quick Accent selector easier to read—is an accessibility enhancement, not the titled spell-checking bug. I suggest closing this mixed issue; if the selector is still too small on a current release, please open a focused Quick Accent accessibility request with Windows text-scaling percentage and a current screenshot.
